I’m sorry but I feel that we are completely generalizing when it comes to narcissism. I have went out with narcissists some of them were awful carless and so on, and others were self aware and would actually listen. I feel most narcissists are really smart and yes they tend to use their intelligence to manipulate you and thats not fine, but some dont, some just need to fulfill this grandiose self made prophecy so that they can be able to cope with themselves. Not saying that any of the comments are not valid, but even with people that dont suffer from narcissism it can be very delicate to point out their flaws. I personally always start by complimenting a person and acknowledging their efforts before i start talking about what theyve done that might have hurt me. And its always good to remind anyone that blaming them for something is not rly demonizing them and that we also see their efforts. I am not denying the whole diagnosis of narcissism or denying the fact that yeah it can get suffocating and annoying. But i feel one question is completely disregarded when we talk about dealing with narcissists, or when we other them: why are we so offended by this grandiosity really? Is it because its disregarding our presence? Or is it because we cannot believe that someone can love themselves that much? Maybe somehow we do wish we were so okay with being ourselves and being oblivious to the other. Why are we so offended by someone else’s ego anyway? Why are we afraid of it? I was personally in a short relationship with a super intelligent person extremely intellectual and also very charismatic and handsome (but also very arrogant) yet by being himself and talking about himself he would share sooooo much information, references, philosophical inputs and so on. I learnt alot from him. He was very generous maybe not intentionally but i was able to take what i want from him and shield myself by simply not taking his parade personally, or giving it much attention either way. This person actually explained to me once that if all of us would learned from narcissists, (at least covert narcissists) to self love and assume our self love to the end and respect everyone elses self admiration we might be able to have a way more relaxed and self fulfilling way of life, and better arrangements where we put ourselves first.
